name: snow-fairy-ally-wakes-up-after-snow-fairy-leaves
notes: Snow Fairy (4s0c9XgLg7): the freeze lasts only "as long as you control CARDNAME". Player 2 has two Dungeon Guides: A (plain) is rested by Snow Fairy's On Enter, B carries two buff counters (3 power). On player 1's next turn Snow Fairy attacks the awake B and dies to its retaliation (3 damage vs 2 life). In player 2's following wake up phase A is no longer frozen: the engine drops the FROZEN_BY_SNOW_FAIRY effect and A wakes up normally.

rulesClauses: The freeze lasts only as long as you control Snow Fairy: once it has left the field the ally wakes up normally.
